summary: Receive admission lends the writer in budgeted loans (128 envelopes or 250 ms, yielding to queued foreground writes) and defers a receive after 10 s with a durable resume cursor; adds pending-envelope and last-receive-page gauges.

replay.detail: Stored envelopes and receipts are unchanged; a deferred receive resumes from a local cursor and never re-admits an envelope.

schema.detail: The resume cursor and receipt epoch are local meta values; no table or index changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: No request or response fields change; a deferred receive uses the existing deferred outcome. Old senders may re-offer a deferred page, and receipt deduplication keeps that idempotent.

recovery.detail: Rolling back leaves an unused local cursor; the previous release admits any remaining pending envelopes as before.
